(Fort Worth, Texas) | college = [[Louisiana Tech Bulldogs basketball|Louisiana Tech]] (2019–2024) | draft_year = 2024 | career_start = 2024 | years1 = {{nbay|2024|full=y}} | team1 = [[Sacramento Kings]] | years2 = [[2024–25 NBA G League season|2024–2025]] | team2 = →[[Stockton Kings]] | years3 = {{nbay|2025|start}}–present | team3 = [[Houston Rockets]] | years4 = [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2025–2026]] | team4 = →[[Rio Grande Valley Vipers]] | highlights = * [[NBA G League champion]] ([[2024–25 NBA G League season|2025]]) * [[Conference USA Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Conference USA Player of the Year]] (2024) * First-team All-[[Conference USA]] (2024) * 2× Third-team All-Conference USA (2021, 2023) * Conference USA Defensive Player of the Year (2024) * Conference USA All-Defensive team (2024) }} '''Isaiah Jordan Crawford''' (born November 1, 2001) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Houston Rockets]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Louisiana Tech Bulldogs basketball|Louisiana Tech Bulldogs]]. Crawford has also previously been on a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Rio Grande Valley Vipers]] of the [[NBA G League]]. ==College career== Crawford, a [[small forward]] from [[Fort Worth, Texas]], came to Louisiana Tech from [[North Crowley High School]]. He broke into the Bulldogs' starting lineup six games into his first year but his season ended abruptly due to an [[anterior cruciate ligament]] (ACL) injury.{{cite news |last=Vitamanti |first=Jenna |date=February 6, 2024 |title=Isaiah Crawford’s record-breaking season comes after hardship |url=https://www.ktalnews.com/sports/local-sports/la-tech/louisiana-tech-basketball-isaiah-crawfords-record-breaking-season-after-multiple-injuries/ |access-date=March 15, 2024 |website=ktalnews.com}} He returned to the team for his sophomore season, establishing himself a third-team All-[[Conference USA]] pick after averaging 11.8 points and 5.4 rebounds per game. Just two games into his junior season, Crawford suffered a second ACL injury to the same knee and missed the rest of the season.{{cite news |last=McGuire |first=Kane |date=October 23, 2023 |title=Two-Time Knee Injury, Two-Time All-Conference: Louisiana Tech’s Isaiah Crawford |url=https://crescentcitysports.com/two-time-knee-injury-two-time-all-conference-isaiah-crawford-louisiana-tech/ |access-date=March 15, 2024 |website=crescentcitysports.com}} After a year of rehabilitation, Crawford returned to the Bulldogs for the 2022–23 season. He picked up where he left off, averaging 13.7 points per game to lead the team and was again named third-team all-conference. At the start of the 2023–24 season, Crawford was named the preseason Conference USA Player of the Year.{{cite web |date=October 12, 2023 |title=MBB: CUSA Announces Men’s Basketball Preseason Poll, All-Conference Team |url=https://conferenceusa.com/news/2023/10/12/mbb-cusa-announces-mens-basketball-preseason-poll-all-conference-team.aspx |access-date=March 15, 2024 |website=conferenceusa.com}} After averaging career highs in points (16.3 per game) and rebounding (6.2 per game) and leading the Bulldogs to a second-place finish, Crawford was named the league's 2024 [[Conference USA Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Player of the Year]].{{cite news |last=Hedges |first=Russell |date=March 11, 2024 |title=Men’s college basketball: Louisiana Tech’s Crawford named CUSA Player of the Year |url=https://press-herald.com/mens-college-basketball-louisiana-techs-crawford-named-cusa-player-of-the-year/ |access-date=March 15, 2024 |publisher=Minden Press-Herald}} ==Professional career== After going undrafted in the [[2024 NBA draft]], Crawford signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Sacramento Kings]] on July 3, 2024.{{cite web |last=Maher |first=Rory |date=July 3, 2024 |title=Kings Sign Isaiah Crawford, Isaac Jones To Two-Way Deals |url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/07/kings-to-sign-isaiah-crawford-isaac-jones-to-two-way-deals.html |access-date=July 3, 2024 |website=HoopsRumors.com}}{{cite web |date=July 3, 2024 |title=Sacramento Kings Sign Isaiah Crawford and Isaac Jones to Two-Way Contracts |url=https://www.nba.com/kings/news/sacramento-kings-sign-isaiah-crawford-and-isaac-jones-to-two-way-contracts |access-date=July 3, 2024 |website=NBA.com}} Crawford made 15 appearances for Sacramento during his rookie campaign, recording averages of 0.9 points, 0.5 rebounds, and 0.1 assists.{{Cite web|title=Isaiah Crawford 2024-25 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4592857/type/nba/year/2025|access-date=August 25, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} On July 26, 2025, Crawford signed a two-way contract with the [[Houston Rockets]].{{cite web | last=Elijah | first=Alec | title=Houston Rockets Sign Isaiah Crawford to Two-Way Deal | website=Houston Rockets On SI | date=2025-07-28 | url=https://www.si.com/nba/rockets/onsi/news/houston-rockets-sign-isaiah-crawford-to-two-way-deal-kings | access-date=2025-12-05}} He made 14 appearances for Houston during the [[2025–26 NBA season]], averaging 2.0 points, 1.1 rebounds, and 0.4 assists.{{Cite web|title=Isaiah Crawford 2025-26 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4592857/type/nba/year/2026|access-date=August 25, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} On July 23, 2026, Crawford re–signed with the Rockets on a two–way contract.{{Cite web|title=Rockets Re-Sign Isaiah Crawford|url=https://www.nba.com/rockets/news/rockets-re-sign-isaiah-crawford|access-date=August 25, 2026|website=nba.com|language=en}}
